title: Prefunding Reserve Standard — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
## Standard

1. *No longer in force as an unqualified clause:* "After each regular batch the funding balance must still hold the package's reserve percent of the average of the program's most recent regular batches." This clause is no longer in force as written; it is superseded by the current reserve basis, under which this reserve still applies for every purpose other than working out a restoring payment.
2. When the funding balance of a Paystride Payroll Card Program does not hold that reserve after a regular batch, the employer is asked to restore it within the package's restore period in business days; the batch itself still posts if it was funded.
3. *No longer in force as an unqualified clause:* "Packages with a zero reserve percentage hold no reserve." This clause is no longer in force as written; it is superseded by the current reserve basis, under which it still holds outside a restoring payment.
4. A funding balance left negative for more than the package's negative-balance period in business days suspends the program under the program lifecycle rules.

## The reserve figure

The reserve after a regular batch is the package's reserve percent, taken as a number of percent, of the average amount of the program's most recent regular batches before today, as many of them as the package averages.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical Select package program whose three most recent regular batches before today were 21,400.00, 19,950.00 and 22,330.00 has an average regular batch of 21,226.67; at 5 percent the reserve is 1,061.33. A balance of 900.00 after the next regular batch falls short, and the employer is asked to restore it within 5 business days, while the batch still posts if it was funded.

## Negative balance cases (hypothetical, Standard package, 3 business days)

| Business days the balance has stayed negative | Suspension |
|---|---|
| 3 | not yet |
| 4 | the program is suspended |

Packages with a zero reserve percentage hold no reserve.
